name: proto-blocks/cadco-contact
title: Cadco Contact
description: An introduction and the ways to reach Cadco on the left, a chosen Gravity Forms form on the right.

links.label: Ways to get in touch
links.help: A telephone number is written tel:8607382500 and an address mailto:sales@cadco-ltd.com; the icon follows from which one it is.

formId.label: Form
formId.help: Gravity Forms supplies this list. Choosing none leaves the column empty, which is what an editor sees before a form exists.

showTitle.label: Show the form's own title
showTitle.help: Off by default: the heading above the form already names it, and Gravity Forms would repeat it.
